statusText: A fifth US cash hour has passed with the day low still at the opening print, and the stall seen an hour ago resolved upward rather than into a pullback. NDX is 30,447.33 (+2.71%), 4.5 points under a fresh 30,451.86 high, NQ is 2.25 under its own high, and semiconductors re-accelerated to +3.98%. Tail firms one step to 32. Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES.
recommendation: A narrow elevated-risk window is flagged from 18:00Z to 20:00Z, covering the remainder of the US cash session including the power hour. Directional efficiency inside that window remains high enough that mean reversion is unreliable. The forecast has conditional Tail stepping toward the elevated floor at the 20:00Z cash close, into the watch band from 21:00Z and into the low band from 22:00Z, with a secondary conditional rise into Tuesday's US open and the clustered Richmond Fed and Fed-speaker hour that follows it. The horizon contains no strong-block or off state at any hour.
headline: Nasdaq-100 breaks its stall to a fresh high in a fifth cash hour with the day low still the opening print
body:
The NDX cash index was 30,447.33 (+2.71%, +803.16) at 18:26Z against a 29,933.22-30,451.86 day range, an open of 29,947.16 and Friday's 29,644.17 close. NQ futures traded 30,737.75 (+2.74%) on a 29,904.00-30,740.00 range. Both instruments sit within five points of their session highs. The stall recorded in the previous hourly assessment, when the index went from 30,370.05 to 30,370.55 and gave back a marginal new high, has resolved: the index added roughly 77 points over this hour and set a fresh extreme at 30,451.86. The day low is still the opening print, so five cash hours have now passed without a genuine retracement.

Cross-asset confirmation re-accelerated rather than decaying. The PHLX Semiconductor index is 12,396.17 (+3.98%) with a new high at 12,405.63, up from the +3.54% reading an hour earlier; ARM is up about 16%, Intel about 12% and AMD about 9%, the latter through a $1 trillion market capitalisation at an all-time high above $608. Delayed latest-session context shows all eight tracked megacaps and all seven tracked semiconductor names positive, with Meta the standout near +10%. The Treasury curve is lower, the 10-year at 4.97% after a 2.4bp decline and the 2-year at 4.76%. WTI is $95.65 (-4.63%) and Brent $100.45 (-3.29%), an 11-day low attributed to US-Iran diplomacy around the UN General Assembly and to unobstructed Strait of Hormuz shipments, though crude has ticked up from the $95.02 low-water mark of an hour ago.

Underlying participation is the clearest counterweight. Current reporting notes that more than half of S&P 500 constituents trade below their 200-day moving average and that NYSE downside volume reached about 54% of total volume, near its year-to-date high, while the Dow is up only 0.73% against the Nasdaq's 2.19% composite gain. Single-name dispersion is extreme, with ARM and Intel up double digits against Microsoft at +0.6%. That is a narrow, concentrated advance rather than a broad one.

The assessment follows the price path. Five cash hours with the day low unchanged at the open, both instruments pinned within five points of their session extremes, and a stall hour that resolved to a new high instead of a first pullback together constitute the observed persistent-directional-efficiency case in which mean reversion is denied long enough to matter. That combination of repeated extension after a failed consolidation and session-extreme holding is what justifies firming Tail one step to 32 rather than holding it. Two features continue to cap the reading well below the strong-block threshold. VIX is 15.04 inside a 14.60-15.13 range, describing an orderly grind rather than violent repricing, and today's US calendar is exhausted, with the Chicago Fed National Activity Index printed at -0.04 and the bill auctions cleared, so there is no domestic release left to supply a delayed second information wave. Narrow breadth raises Stress and lowers directional conviction without itself raising Tail. The elevated window is therefore drawn narrowly from 18:00Z to 20:00Z, covering the remaining cash session including the power hour, and conditional Tail decays from the close onward. A first genuine retracement remains the clearest invalidation; sustained trade above 30,451.86 into the close would be the clearest escalation. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this mapping.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours record a regime change that has now been running for five cash hours. Through Sunday evening and the Asian session conditions were quiet and range-consistent, with Tail between 5 and 9 and mode normal. From 06:00Z a steady bid built on the crude retreat and the verified server-CPU repricing: mode turned trend-up and Tail ratcheted from 5 to 22 across eight hourly assessments, crossing into the watch band at 11:00Z while confidence improved from 81 to 86. The 14:00Z assessment recorded the first crossing into the elevated band at the cash open at Tail 26, and 15:00Z, 16:00Z and 17:00Z read 28, 30 and 30. Seventeen of the 24 hours carried a mapped EA_ON state and only the final four reached the block threshold, so the current reading is an extension of a four-hour-old escalation rather than a steady state.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the elevated band through the remainder of the US cash session including the power hour, narrows toward the elevated floor at the 20:00Z cash close as the auction clears and index liquidity thins, returns to the watch band from 21:00Z and to the low band from 22:00Z. The overnight path returns to the quiet range baseline the lookback shows is typical outside US hours, then drifts up with Tuesday's European liquidity and again into Tuesday's US open, which is the horizon's key structural checkpoint at conditional Tail 22, peaking at 24 in the following hour where the Richmond Fed index and the Williams and Jefferson speeches cluster. The horizon contains no strong-block or off state at any hour. Only the current clock-hour slot states observed structure as fact; every later hour frames structure conditionally, because no price path after 18:26Z has been observed. The current reading rests on five cash hours with the day low still at the open, so it should decay quickly once a genuine retracement appears. Confidence declines steadily with distance from the current evidence set. Wednesday's flash PMIs, Meta's September 23-24 Connect event and the September 24 Trump-Xi state dinner are the next regime-relevant catalysts, alongside the ongoing UN General Assembly and the Iranian delegation's arrival in New York.
